subject: [PATCH 36/60] mm: refuse explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to prevent explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes by adding checks in the compaction and vmscan code paths. However, it does not address memoryless nodes that continue to accept such requests.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the Linux kernel to prevent explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes, which do not have memory allocated. It achieves this by adding checks in the compaction and vmscan code paths to reject such requests for private nodes.
